candidates.name: trim_peak10
candidates.reason: Trim unit 10 at hour 13, a block end with favorable local decommitment gradient and sufficient reported capacity margin; retain the peak hour commitment.

candidates.name: trim_peak10_tail4
candidates.reason: Combine the unit 10 hour 13 block-end trim with shutting unit 4 for the final low-load hour; its fixed-cost reduction must offset shutdown cost and earlier ramp-down effects.

candidates.name: stagger_tail_3_4
candidates.reason: Trim unit 10 at hour 13 and turn unit 4 off for hours 23-24 while extending unit 3 through hour 23. Staggering these shutdowns preserves more ramping capability before the low-load tail.

candidates.name: trim_peak9
